fact: Techweez reports Kenya is migrating from NEMIS to the Kenya Education Management Information System (KEMIS), which became the required platform for the 2026 Grade 10 selection, with the PS telling the Public Accounts Committee that KEMIS is not yet complete.

Biometric Update reports Kenya will begin a pilot in July 2025 of the Kenya Education Management Information System (KEMIS) to replace NEMIS, set to fully go live by September, per Principal Secretary Julius Bitok.

The Ministry of Education KEMIS Secretariat circular says KEMIS holds learner records marked Valid or Invalid by an operational Learner Validation Engine and generates a Unique Learner Identifier (ULI) for learners in schools.

The Daily Nation reports that Kenya's government migrated in September 2025 from NEMIS to KEMIS, an integrated system designed to consolidate student records across the education sector from early childhood to tertiary.
